findings.where: End of the page, the coral 'Browse destinations' button after 'Scoring method' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: The page's one coral button has fully rounded pill ends. The project's primary button has 8 px control corners, and it keeps pill shapes for badges, tags and status chips. So this button is shaped unlike the main action everywhere else on the site, and it borrows the shape the brand uses for labels.
findings.who_objects: The founder, who owns the brand sheet: the coral main action is meant to look the same on every page. A returning visitor who has seen the square-cornered search button on the home page meets a differently shaped one here. Because pills mean badges and status chips in this system, the button also reads a little like a label rather than an action.
